Dead Weight::desc.dst: 圖騰的水平速度大幅提升，但垂直移動能力降低。

major-id#0297.src: Totemic Shatter heals {~} of Regeneration's usual amount at the cost of {~} blocks of radius.
major-id#0297.dst: Totemic Shatter 恢復的量變為 Regeneration 平常的 {~1}，代價是半徑減少 {~2} 格。
major-id#0297._raw: Totemic Shatter heals 75% of Regeneration's usual amount at the cost of 2 blocks of radius.

major-id#0298.src: Totemic Smash deals {#}+{~}, {#}+{~}, {#}+{~}, and {#}+{~} but totemic smash loses {~} radius.
major-id#0298._raw: Totemic Smash deals +150%, +150%, +150%, and +120% but totemic smash loses 30% radius.

major-id#0299.src: Turn Double Slice into a {~}-hit pummeling of {~} damage per hit.
major-id#0299.dst: Double Slice 變成 {~1} 段的連續猛擊，每一段造成 {~2} 傷害。
major-id#0299._raw: Turn Double Slice into a 10-hit pummeling of 16% damage per hit.

major-id#0300.src: Turns Smoke Bomb into firecrackers that fly farther, tighter, and deal {#}{~}, {#}{~}, {#}{~}, and {#}{~} instantly.
major-id#0300.dst: Smoke Bomb 變成飛得更遠、散布更集中的鞭炮，並立即造成 {#}{~1}、{#}{~2}、{#}{~3} 與 {#}{~4}。
major-id#0300._raw: Turns Smoke Bomb into firecrackers that fly farther, tighter, and deal 100%, 30%, 30%, and 30% instantly.

major-id#0301.src: Uncontainable Corruption decreases Corrupted duration by {~} and gives drastically more damage, but disables Enraged Blow. Massacre adds {~} times as much corruption.
major-id#0301.dst: Uncontainable Corruption 使 Corrupted 的持續時間縮短 {~1}，傷害大幅提升，但停用 Enraged Blow。Massacre 累積的腐化量變為 {~2} 倍。
major-id#0301._raw: Uncontainable Corruption decreases Corrupted duration by 75% and gives drastically more damage, but disables Enraged Blow. Massacre adds 5 times as much corruption.

Roving Assassin::desc.src: Vanish will no longer block mana and health regeneration.
Roving Assassin::desc.dst: Vanish 不再阻止魔力與生命恢復。

major-id#0303.src: Violent Vortex applies {~} marks to every enemy it hits.
major-id#0303.dst: Violent Vortex 會對每一個命中的敵人施加 {~} 層標記。
major-id#0303._raw: Violent Vortex applies 2 marks to every enemy it hits.

major-id#0304.src: Walk Speed increases by {~} and Jump Height increases by {~} for every {~} hp missing.
major-id#0304.dst: 每損失 {~3} 生命值，移動速度提高 {~1}，跳躍高度提高 {~2}。
major-id#0304._raw: Walk Speed increases by 1% and Jump Height increases by 2% for every 1% hp missing.

Clamber::desc.src: Wall Jump becomes a sheer vertical climb.
Clamber::desc.dst: Wall Jump 變為垂直攀登。

major-id#0306.src: When Second Chance activates, all allies within {~} blocks of you get a {~} damage boost for {~}s.
major-id#0306.dst: Second Chance 觸發時，{~1} 格內的所有友軍獲得 {~2} 傷害加成，持續 {~3} 秒。
major-id#0306._raw: When Second Chance activates, all allies within 10 blocks of you get a 20% damage boost for 15s.

major-id#0307.src: When using Heal, cast one instant pulse that heals {~} of your max health.
major-id#0307.dst: 使用 Heal 時，額外施放一次瞬間脈動，恢復你 {~} 的最大生命值。
major-id#0307._raw: When using Heal, cast one instant pulse that heals 15% of your max health.

major-id#0308.src: When you are within Totem range, the Totem becomes Primed, adding {~} of your Poison ID every {~}s. Hitting a Primed totem with Uproot will create a {~} block wide poison cloud instantly dealing the stored Poison.
major-id#0308.dst: 當你位於圖騰範圍內時，圖騰會進入蓄勢狀態，每 {~2} 秒累積你 {~1} 的中毒詞條。以 Uproot 擊中蓄勢中的圖騰，會立刻生成 {~3} 格寬的毒雲，並釋放累積的毒傷。
major-id#0308._raw: When you are within Totem range, the Totem becomes Primed, adding 4% of your Poison ID every 0.25s. Hitting a Primed totem with Uproot will create a 6 block wide poison cloud instantly dealing the stored Poison.

major-id#0309.src: When your sprint bar is under {~} full, increase your sprint speed by +{~}.
major-id#0309.dst: 衝刺條低於 {~1} 時，衝刺速度提高 +{~2}。
major-id#0309._raw: When your sprint bar is under 30% full, increase your sprint speed by +150%.

major-id#0310.src: While above {~} maximum health, allies within {~} blocks gain {~} increased health gain from all sources and {~} Walk Speed.
major-id#0310.dst: 當自身生命值高於最大生命值的 {~1} 時，{~2} 格範圍內的友軍從所有來源獲得的生命值恢復量提高 {~3}，並獲得 {~4} 移動速度。
major-id#0310._raw: While above 80% maximum health, allies within 12 blocks gain 15% increased health gain from all sources and 25% Walk Speed.

major-id#0311.src: While under {~} maximum health, allies within {~} blocks gain {~} bonus damage and defence.
major-id#0311.dst: 當自身最大生命值降至 {~1} 以下，周圍 {~2} 格內的友軍將會獲得 {~3} 傷害加成與防禦。
major-id#0311._raw: While under 50% maximum health, allies within 8 blocks gain 15% bonus damage and defence.

major-id#0312.src: While vanished, lose {~} of your max mana per second. Surprise Strike further increases your damage by {~} per mana lost from this effect, up to {~}.
major-id#0312.dst: 隱身期間每秒消耗 {~1} 最大魔力。此效果每消耗一點魔力，Surprise Strike 的傷害就提高 {~2}，上限為 {~3}。
major-id#0312._raw: While vanished, lose 5% of your max mana per second. Surprise Strike further increases your damage by 3% per mana lost from this effect, up to 70%.

Old Spark::desc.src: Whirlwind transforms into a travelling projectile, exploding on contact and knocking enemies into the air. Crouch to rise with them.
Old Spark::desc.dst: Whirlwind 變成向前飛行的投射物，接觸時爆炸並把敵人擊飛。蹲下可隨之升空。

major-id#0314.src: You can now have twice the Nightcloak Knives, but they each deal {~} less damage.
major-id#0314.dst: 現在可以同時存在兩倍的 Nightcloak Knives，但每把造成的傷害降低 {~}。
major-id#0314._raw: You can now have twice the Nightcloak Knives, but they each deal 30% less damage.

major-id#0315.src: You deal {~} more damage for every block you are away from your target (Max {~}).
major-id#0315.dst: 你與目標每相隔一格，造成的傷害就提高 {~1}(上限 {~2})。
major-id#0315._raw: You deal 2% more damage for every block you are away from your target (Max 120%).

Lightweight::desc.src: You no longer take fall damage.

major-id#0317.src: Your Maximum Health is reduced by {~}. For every {~} HP lost, Sacred Surge's damage is increased by {~}.
major-id#0317.dst: 你的最大生命上限削減 {~1}，每被削減 {~2} 點生命值，Sacred Surge 的傷害增加 {~3}。
major-id#0317._raw: Your Maximum Health is reduced by 75%. For every 100 HP lost, Sacred Surge's damage is increased by 3%.

Peaceful Effigy::desc.src: Your Totem will last twice as long.
Peaceful Effigy::desc.dst: 你的圖騰持續時間延長為兩倍。

major-id#0319.src: Your hound gains {~} more movement speed, attack speed and vision. Arrow Bomb's damage is reduced by {#}-{~}.
major-id#0319.dst: 你的獵犬獲得 {~1} 移動速度、攻擊速度與視野，但 Arrow Bomb 的傷害降低 {#}{~2}。
major-id#0319._raw: Your hound gains 50% more movement speed, attack speed and vision. Arrow Bomb's damage is reduced by -30%.

major-id#0320.src: Your maximum Mana Bank is increased by {~}, but your spells now charge it by -{~} less per hit.
major-id#0320.dst: 魔力儲庫的上限提高 {~1}，但技能每次命中的充能量減少 {~2}。
major-id#0320._raw: Your maximum Mana Bank is increased by 50, but your spells now charge it by -3 less per hit.

major-id#0321.src: Your puppets have a lifetime of {~} seconds and deal {~} increased damage with attacks and explosions.
major-id#0321.dst: 你的傀儡存在 {~1} 秒，且攻擊與爆炸的傷害提高 {~2}。
major-id#0321._raw: Your puppets have a lifetime of 3 seconds and deal 50% increased damage with attacks and explosions.
